channel.title: Abstract Voyage
channel.description: Manuel Cerdas is a creative engineer and consultant working across AI engineering, product strategy, systems thinking, and expressive web interfaces.

item.title: Infinity Labs, and why engineering education should be free
item.description: An open YouTube channel offering lessons on software architecture, design patterns, languages, and frameworks for engineers from junior to senior level.

item.title: A biomimetic framework for interfaces that feel human
item.description: An early, implementation-agnostic framework that maps five traits of effective human communication onto interface design, aiming to lower user rejection and improve adoption.

item.title: The Tech Lead is a dependency your team should outgrow
item.description: Coordination is a function, not a person. When every member can perform it, the team stops having a single point of failure at the top.

item.title: Five years as a tech lead: accountability and team ownership
item.description: A candid retrospective on the role's rewards (influence, exposure, recognition) and its costs (absorbing stakeholder pressure, taking the blame), with the recurring lesson being to distribute ownership across the team.

item.title: Four kinds of dependency, and which ones carry real risk
item.description: A two-axis way to examine software dependencies by origin and whether they are inherent or introduced, with examples of the risks each can create.

item.title: Real-time feature toggles with React and LaunchDarkly
item.description: A working implementation with higher-order components and streaming updates, so flags change in a running app without a redeploy.

item.title: Technical debt works like a credit card
item.description: Both extremes fail. Ship nothing until it is perfect and you never ship; borrow without repaying and the interest eventually takes the whole team.

item.title: The DOM, from nodes to events
item.description: How the browser turns markup into a tree, how nodes relate to each other, and where JavaScript actually attaches when you bind an event.

item.title: Gzipping and minification solve different problems
item.description: One removes characters from your source, the other compresses what travels over the wire. Using either alone leaves the other's savings on the table.

item.title: The five SOLID principles, one at a time
item.description: Single responsibility through dependency inversion, each with a short example of the problem it exists to prevent.
